Voice calibration profiles for capacity-aware narration (Mức 3). Rates measured empirically from real TTS output, not guessed. words_per_sec is the AGGREGATE narrated rate (total words / total speaking seconds). words_per_sec_conservative = mean - 0.5*std, used for max-capacity word ceilings so a fit line never overruns. Calibrate with: python -m pipeline.calibration --project

--voice .
